newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end bourse down as nerves creep back.
newsitem.headline: German shares end bourse down as nerves creep back.

text.p: 1245 GMT - German shares end bourse dealings lower as the dollar neared its lowest level for over a week and with nervousness creeping back about the U.S. market after a fall in the S&P futures contract.
* December DAX future down 46 points at 2,843.5 points.
* Hoechst down, but firmer than the trend after makes buy out bid for French Roussel Uclaf.
* Dollar hovering above 1.54 marks, weighing on exporting chemicals and auto stocks in particular.
* Market waiting for U.S. PPI data at 1330 GMT.
